name: NexWall Wallpaper REST API
description: NexWall Wallpaper API by KodNex Technologies is a free wallpaper REST API (JSON) built for wallpaper apps on Android, Flutter, iOS, React Native, web and Python: phone-portrait HD wallpapers up to 4K across 49 categories, plus live (video) wallpapers on Ultra. Free plan: 100 requests/day, 60 requests/minute, 1 API key, no credit card, commercial use allowed; every plan, including Free, may be used in free or paid apps under the NexWall Developer API License. Try it with no API key and no signup: GET https://nexwall.kodnextech.com/api/developer/v1/demo/wallpapers (keyless demo, Free-plan content, limited to 10 requests/minute and 30 requests/day per IP). A free API key is issued immediately at https://nexwall.kodnextech.com/developers/register; send it as `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY`. CORS is enabled (*) for browser apps. Free keys include non-premium image content. Pro keys (plan value `premium`): 10,000 requests/day, 180 requests/minute, 3 keys, premium image categories; ₹399/month or ₹3,999/year ($4.99/month or $49.99/year). Ultra keys: 50,000 requests/day, 300 requests/minute, 5 keys, premium and live (video) wallpaper content; ₹899/month or ₹8,999/year ($10.99/month or $109.99/year). Python client: `pip install nexwall`. Guides for Flutter, Android (Kotlin), React Native, iOS SwiftUI, Next.js and Python: https://nexwall.kodnextech.com/wallpaper-api/guides
